summary: Split large module: koru.autonomous into cohesive submodules

delivery.outcome: src/koru/autonomous.py (1240 lines, 77 methods) becomes the koru.autonomous package: __init__.py keeps every historical monkeypatch-compatible facade wrapper, reporting.py owns the doctor/status/self-heal environment reporting, and argv_config.py owns argv normalization plus auto-mode flag configuration. Behavior is unchanged: all names in the former module __all__, _consume_web_flag and every test monkeypatch target stay importable from koru.autonomous, and focused regression tests cover the two extracted submodules.
nonGoals: Changing any facade wrapper behavior or dependency-forwarding semantics
Altering the CLI surface in src/koru/cli_auto.py or src/koru/cli.py
Renaming or removing any public or test-referenced name

architecture.decision: Convert the module to a package whose __init__.py keeps the monkeypatch facade (wrappers read facade globals at call time) while reporting.py and argv_config.py own the two cohesive responsibilities that tests never monkeypatch, re-exported through the facade for backwards compatibility.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; the previous single-module facade is restored verbatim.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -c "import koru.autonomous as m; assert all(hasattr(m, n) for n in m.__all__); assert hasattr(m, '_consume_web_flag')"
validation.evidence: Every former public and test-referenced name resolves through the package facade.
Facade monkeypatch compatibility suites pass unmodified.
Focused regression tests cover the extracted submodules.

commands: ruff check src/koru/autonomous && ruff format --check src/koru/autonomous
validation.evidence: Lint and format pass on the new package.
Governance gate passes with zero errors.
